reviews.title: Was once helpful.
reviews.text:
As you may have seen, this app used to be a safe space for a lot of people. This app helped me at a bad time in my life, and I eventually became a  mentor so I could help others and heal myself along the way. When the app shut down, many of us lost connections to new friends, journal entries, and our safe place. I used to have a daily check in with a particular person, so they could keep their well-being in check. I wish we had some sort of warning when it left us. 

I hope that it comes back someday, and we can all reconnect and get our little home back.

reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.text: I was a mod on this app and miss it dearly. First it was my own safe space, and then I was privileged to help it remain others’ safe space by moderating and mentoring. I met some of the most incredible people and the most supportive online mental health community. It went through phases of change but it was always Sup and we all loved it. It’s heartbreaking that this supportive space no longer exists and that the friendships and connections we made are lost. Sending much love to all of the former sup community members, mods and the developer. I hope you are all doing okay 💗

reviews.title: Was a nice app, sad to see how it was left.
reviews.text:
I typically never write reviews for apps and I may be over sharing here for closure’s sake but opening up is sort of what this app was all about. Back in 2020 when I was around 17 or 18 and just mentally and emotionally at my lowest point from Anxiety and other aspects of life, I turned to this app for some potential solace and confide with others about the things that were tearing me up inside and to hopefully uplift others as well. For what it was worth, the community and people I had spoken to were genuinely lovely and a delight to speak with even in one off interactions and the venting and emotional calendars were neat as well. 

However, as my life began to change after high school I began to unintentionally grow more and more distant from the app and the community as my emotional and communication skills were underdeveloped (I’m still very flawed and it’s something I chastise myself for to this day) and I had sadly left it. I did remember this app recently and felt awful about how I left out of the blue like that and hoped to reach out to others still around. I was disappointed to find though that the app was seemingly abandoned and has stopped receiving any support and future updates. As I type this I’ve been stuck on the loading screen for a while with no way of logging in. I was expecting at the very least to see some sort of shut down announcement somewhere but just nothing as I noticed many others had dealt with the same issue months ago. Not writing this to call out any developer as I don’t know their situation but it’s still sad to see as right now it is seemingly unusable. 

My long and drawn out point being, as this app went by many names, Sup was a great means of creating community through supporting others going through it and find finding that same level of support through the wonderful people on here and it is a shame that this project was just left in the dust like this without any closure of its status. To those who I may have encountered on here, I hope y’all are doing great, living amazing lives and wish you nothing but the best and to those who took the time to read this review, I hope the same for you as well. :)
